name: We are the Literature Club II
source:
A parody of Rockstar Games’ Red Dead Redemption II in DDLC’s style, bringing to life a new arc in We Are The Literature Club’s story. Set during a heavily competitive festival revolving around literature (in which the whole town is in on), the Literature Club does everything in their power to collect the most literature out of all the attending clubs. This leads to the club president doing everything she can to win, which sometimes results in her ambition getting the best of her. Caught in the crossfire is our protagonist, who is trying to make the best of the situation.

It falls on you to help him make the right choices. Will you be able to help the other club members cope, or focus on more selfish means to resolve the conflicts that arise?

[From [url=https://dokimods.me/mods/we-are-the-literature-club-ii]DokiMods[/url]]
translation:
以《心跳文學社！》的風格，戲仿Rockstar Games的《碧血狂殺 2》，為《We Are The Literature Club》的故事帶來全新的篇章。故事發生在一場競爭激烈、全鎮參與的文學節上。文學社想盡一切辦法，要比其他參賽社團收集到更多文學作品。為此，社長不惜用盡手段爭取勝利，有時也因此被自己的野心衝昏頭腦。主角被夾在這場紛爭中，只能努力讓局面儘可能好轉。

幫助他做出正確選擇的任務，就交給你了。你會幫助其他社員渡過難關，還是專注於更自私的方式，解決接踵而來的衝突？

［摘自[url=https://dokimods.me/mods/we-are-the-literature-club-ii]DokiMods[/url]］
